method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Full-screen stopwatch
features.verse_evidence: stopwatch/index.html Start / Reset; F full screen

features.name: Countdown timer with alarm
features.detail: set hours, minutes, seconds; alarm at zero
features.verse_evidence: Countdown timer: Length, Set, Start, "Alarm sound on", Test sound

features.name: Split / lap timer
features.verse_evidence: Lap button; table Lap / Split / Change / Total, fastest and slowest marked

features.name: Interval timer
features.detail: work/rest rounds that repeat, full screen; custom timers can be saved
features.verse_evidence: stopwatch/index.html #iv: work, rest, rounds, sets, rest between sets, get ready; Tabata/HIIT/EMOM/circuit presets; tones at each change and 3-2-1 ticks; ?iv= link (lib/stopwatch.js intervalSteps)

features.name: Saved custom timers
features.detail: premium members save their own timers
features.verse_evidence: Save as preset keeps your own countdowns on this device (free), each with a remove button

features.name: Choice of alarm sounds
features.verse_evidence: Alarm: Beeps, Bell, Chime, Digital watch, Gong, all made on the device

features.name: Chess clock
features.detail: two-player clock (and a counting-down chess timer)
features.verse_evidence: stopwatch/index.html #cc: two tap clocks, Fischer increment, move counts, pause, flag on time out, bullet to classical presets, ?cc=3+2 link (lib/stopwatch.js chessTap)

features.name: Race timers
features.detail: random races between 6 characters free, up to 100 for premium

features.name: Classroom / fun themed timers
features.detail: bomb, candle and other animated timers for class

features.name: Exam timers
features.verse_evidence: full-screen countdown (F) serves; no exam-specific layout (time remaining + end time)

features.name: Clocks
features.verse_evidence: clock on the stage (skills/clock.js) and /time/; not on /stopwatch/

features.name: Random name pickers
features.detail: free name pickers; premium saves name lists
features.verse_evidence: /wheel/ (Verse page), entries kept in the link

features.name: Holiday countdowns
features.detail: countdown to Christmas and other dates

features.name: Downloadable stay-on-top stopwatch app
features.verse_evidence: no desktop app; the page installs offline (sw.js)

features.name: Premium: ad-free and extras
features.detail: paid membership removes ads and unlocks saved timers, lists, more racers
features.verse_evidence: Verse has no ads at all and nothing to pay

verse_extra: Time kept as the moment it started: a reload or background tab never drifts
Keyboard: Space, L lap, R reset, M mute, F full screen
A link that holds the countdown
Alarm made on the device, works offline
Stopwatch and timer on one page
